additional_info.subject: RE: 0406549 - ID0406549-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP / R8 170002515] FailsafeMode_Active CRM:02023000504
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0406549 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2
) to the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
We have received a case from an end customer concerning the failsafe mode.
Please carry out the following steps:
Perform a hard reset on the charger.
Check the connection on the 24V DC bridge terminal to ensure it is not causing any power supply issues to SECC.
Verify that the router's Ethernet port or Ethernet switch port is not loose.
Inspect for any loose connections to the OCPP router and the LAN cable of the router.
Connect with MobaXterm and check for device scans to identify any devices that are not responding.
Continuous reboots and subsequent entry into Failsafe Mode can be attributed to several causes:
One of the FW components (PLC, Router, SECC, ...) is not reachable
RJ45 connector not properly connected on one of the devices
PLC not reachable (e.g. CFastCard corrupted) (Note: this would not notify FailsafeMode in the Error-Flags, since the PLC is not working in this case)
Any software service failing to start.
Additionally, I am providing a link to a knowledge article for your reference; please review it.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_SW_PLC,SECC_Failsafe mode error - Dynamics 365
Reason

Onsite Troubleshooting

Performance monitoring by RC

eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
